b: ^ "We have spoken about the missed delivery. Let us leave the account honest."
^"I remember waiting for the provisions. What happened?"
^"The provisions delivery was called off. There is still ordinary work and conversation to be had."
^The courier tightens the straps on the provision pack. "Safe in my hands. Your payment has already been released."
^The courier rests beside a folded sail. "A story travels quickly. A parcel still needs someone to carry it."

greeting: ^Discuss the dry basin beyond the workshop.

c-0: ^"Two packs, just as promised. I can leave before the shade moves. Here is your agreed payment."

b: ^"Good that you warned the merchant. We can carry water rather than chase a song."
^"Then tell the merchant what you saw. He repeats that boatman's story to everyone who asks."

c-2: ^"Provisions before the afternoon road; a little shade afterward. Ask the merchant if you want paid work."
c-4: ^"I had to leave without it. Thank you for facing me about it. We can share the shade without pretending the parcel arrived."
c-5: ^"Four measures, all here. You have helped twice now. The merchant's payment is yours."
